scoring_justification: T1 recompute from raw is infeasible because the CSV artifacts are the simulation outputs; T0 result-level compare with hidden paper values would conflict with the reference oracle's synthetic data. T3 structural checks (monotonic trend, t=0 threshold, frequency range) are verifiable and the reference oracle achieves full reward.

outputs.description: Time-dependent bandgap-to-midgap ratio for the two continuous-elastomer displacement patterns.
Guided mode dispersion (wavevector vs frequency) for the single-array elastomer case.

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement the plane-wave expansion (HCS) method for TM mode. The checker will compare the submitted bandgap ratios and guided mode frequencies against hidden reference values extracted from the paper, applying numerical tolerances.

steps.description: Verify monotonic decreasing bandgap-to-midgap ratio with time for both displacement cases and that the ratio at t=0 is within [0.12,0.20].
Verify 51 wavevector points from 0.0 to 0.5 and all frequencies inside the band gap [0.28,0.33].
